standard_prerequisites.name: Localization of a category at a right multiplicative system, its calculus of fractions and its functoriality
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Categories, Lemmas labelled categories-lemma-right-localization (Stacks tag 04VH), categories-lemma-properties-right-localization (Stacks tag 04VK) and categories-lemma-morphisms-right-localization (Stacks tag 04VI), invoked at statement line 9479 and proof lines 9489, 9517
standard_prerequisites.use: Supply the localized category C', the fact that the chosen multiplicative system is compatible with the functor, and the calculus of fractions that lets the two representations be assumed to share source and refinement; the equalizer construction itself is in the counted span.

standard_prerequisites.name: Existence of compactifications, absolutely and relative to a proper base
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, Lemma labelled lemma-compactifyable (source line 9387) and Lemma labelled lemma-right-multiplicative-system (source line 9425), invoked at statement line 9482 and proof line 9500
standard_prerequisites.use: Supply that a compactifyable scheme embeds into a proper scheme over S and that a morphism to a proper base may be compactified; the construction of the representing morphism of compactifications is inside the counted span.

core_obligations: Produce a functor C' -> D from the localization and note that it is essentially surjective (proof lines 9487-9495).

Full faithfulness on morphisms: given a morphism f : X -> Y of compactifyable schemes, choose an open immersion of Y into a scheme proper over S and then an embedding of X into a scheme proper over that compactification, obtaining a morphism of compactifications (X, Xbar) -> (Y, Ybar) that induces f (proof lines 9496-9503).

Well definedness: given two pairs representing the same morphism X -> Y, use the right localization lemma to assume a common source and common second component, then take the equalizer Xbar''' of the two proper maps Xbar' -> Xbar'' inside Xbar', which is closed because Xbar'' is separated over S and proper hence again a compactification, and precompose with the map in the multiplicative system to conclude a = b in the localized category (proof lines 9504-9524).
proof_roadmap: Set up the localization functor and record essential surjectivity (proof lines 9487-9495).
Build a representing morphism of compactifications from a morphism of compactifyable schemes (proof lines 9496-9503).
Compare two representations through the equalizer of the two proper maps and the multiplicative system (proof lines 9504-9524).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the forgetful functor (X, Xbar) -> X induces an equivalence between the localization of the category of compactifications at the right multiplicative system introduced in the preceding lemma and the category of compactifyable schemes over a quasi-compact quasi-separated base S (statement lines 9475-9484). The content is the third step of an equivalence check: essential surjectivity is immediate, full faithfulness on morphisms requires constructing, for an arbitrary morphism X -> Y of compactifyable schemes, a compactification of Y followed by a relative compactification of X over it, so that the localized morphism is represented (proof lines 9496-9503); and well definedness requires showing that two such representations producing the same morphism X -> Y are equal in the localized category, which uses the right-localization calculus to assume a common refinement and then takes the equalizer of the two proper maps Xbar' -> Xbar'' inside Xbar', a closed subscheme by separatedness of Xbar'' over S, to precompose with a map in the multiplicative system (proof lines 9504-9524). The equalizer trick is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
